verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from workspace data inside Shortcut. The MCP server and Cursor/Claude Code connections let external agents reach the data, which is an adjacent integration, not an in-product capability. Docs Suggestion Mode only shows changes proposed by human collaborators, not AI suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
